annotations.text:
TODAY

Nine sections, all the same visual weight. Nothing leads, so the eye has nowhere to land. The active booking — the one thing that matters when you have one — sits fourth, below a greeting and a search bar.

REDESIGN

Five sections, in priority order:
1. Live booking — full width, with the hold timer and a progress bar, one tap from food or ticket
2. "Where to?" — the thesis gets the hero, with four wilayas drawn as themselves rather than grey circles
3. The beach map on the front page: real umbrellas, teal free / grey taken / gold VIP, a tethered callout
4. An ASYMMETRIC bento, not a uniform grid — Beaches spans tall as the flagship, experiences run wide in gold, the rest fall into rhythm
5. One editorial row

DARK

On the app's real tokens: bg #0D0D0D, card #121212, border #222222.

One rule worth keeping: the map callout and the rating badge stay LIGHT. They float over imagery, and imagery never themes — darkening them was wrong twice over.

ARABIC — REAL RTL

The whole bento mirrors, not just the text. Arrows and the search glyph flip; edge-anchored overlays swap sides; the carousel runs right-to-left. Tajawal, with more line-height than Montserrat needs at hero size.

BUG FOUND HERE, worth knowing before we build it: bidi reorders space-separated digits inside an RTL run — "4 500" painted as "500 4". Every numeral run needs direction:ltr + unicode-bidi:isolate. This would have shipped.

DESTINATION HUB — the screen AGENT.md calls the key one

This is where destination-first actually pays off: pick Constantine, get its hotels, food and guides in one list rather than three apps. Category tabs always visible with live counts; every row carries its category badge, rating and verified state.

The bottom card is the idea taken to its conclusion — book the hotel, the dinner and the guide together as one trip.

STILL OPEN

· Photography. These are hand-drawn scenes — Algiers' white terraces, Tipaza's Roman columns, Constantine's gorge, the Djanet dunes. They carry more character than generic stock, but real photos of these places are what would finish it.
· Does the beach map hold the front page out of season, or swap for something else?
